_comment: Hand-maintained inventory of what the build cannot learn from vcpkg.
vcpkg ports need no entry: their copyright files are read from the installed tree.
Qt modules come from qt-modules.json (generated by tools/licences/qt_sbom_manifest.py).
See docs/licensing.md for how this file, the generator and the test fit together.
elected: the option under which Qt's modules are distributed with this build.
Quick 3D is offered only as Commercial or GPL-3.0-only, so the whole Qt set is taken under GPL-3.0-only.
If Quick 3D ever leaves the app, Qt's LGPL-3.0-only option becomes available and this changes (docs/licensing.md).

repoNames.qtbase: Qt Base (Core, GUI, Network, Concurrent, platform plugins)
repoNames.qtdeclarative: Qt Declarative (QML, Qt Quick, Quick Controls 2, Labs Settings)

filePrefixes._comment: A deployed plugin whose file name has no entry of its own is attributed to the module that provides the family.

_comment: Qt components windeployqt puts beside the exe although the app names none of them directly.
Windows list: taken from the deployment scan of a real build on 2026-10-13 (Qt 6.8.3, RelWithDebInfo).
macOS, Linux and Android: fill in by running the notices test on a deployment of that platform (E4).

licenseElections._comment: Where a component offers a choice of licences, the option taken. Keys are SPDX expressions as published.

textExemptions._comment: SPDX ids whose terms impose no notice or text-reproduction duty, so no text is bundled for them.
textExemptions.LicenseRef-Qt-Commercial: not a licence this build uses; the commercial option is not elected

_comment: Files the deployment tool puts beside the executable that are neither Qt's nor vcpkg's.
A name listed here is a known one: it is not reported. The value says what it is and what is decided.
A name NOT listed here is reported as a warning by the generator (it does not fail the build).
deployedFiles.clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll: AddressSanitizer runtime copied by cube_deploy_sanitizer_runtime into sanitizer builds only; never installed into a package.
